name: Volans
introduction: is the Flying Fish, introduced by Dutch navigators in the 1590s, who saw these fish leaping from the sea. It is a small constellation near the south celestial pole.

sections.title: What makes it special
paragraphs: Volans contains the Lindsay–Shapley Ring, a galaxy turned into a glowing ring of young stars when a smaller galaxy plunged straight through its center.

sections.title: Notable stars
paragraphs: [Beta Volantis](hip:41312) is an orange giant, [Gamma² Volantis](hip:34481) part of a beautiful double, and [Alpha Volantis](hip:44382) a white star.

sections.title: Beyond the stars
paragraphs: The Meathook Galaxy, NGC 2442, a spiral with one arm distorted by an encounter with a neighbor, also lies in Volans.
